Houlihan Lokey’s U.S. Private Capital Markets & Advisory team provides capital-raising services across industries and for various capital needs. jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, GTM FP&A
jobs.description:
ServiceTitan is seeking an exceptional Senior Financial Analyst, GTM FP&A to join our finance organization in a highly visible and impactful role. The primary focus for this role will be serving as a dedicated FP&A partner who is embedded in the business, close to the decisions that matter, and trusted to bring both the numbers and the narrative.

  

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excel in the ability to work collaboratively across teams, thrive in fast-paced ambiguous environments and have a growth mindset with strong curiosity about our business and industry. At ServiceTitan, we value strategic thinking at every level of the organization. You will be empowered to challenge the status quo, dream big, and drive meaningful impact as we pursue ambitious goals together.

**What you'll do:**

* Drive the monthly close process: have a deep understanding of monthly performance, prepare variance commentary, understand accruals, and raise any risks and opportunities to both finance and GTM leadership teams
* Manage headcount and expense planning: lead the monthly forecasts and annual operating plan to translate business needs among the GTM teams you support into accurate forecasts
* Turn data into decisions: build a deep command of the P&L to diagnose what's driving performance, shape strategic narratives, and partner with leadership on high-impact, ad hoc analyses that move the business forward
* Dig into the data: uncover trends, risks, and opportunities by understanding the unit economics and efficiency drivers that underpin the business, and come to the table with a clear point of view on budget and financial trade-offs
* Be a trusted business partner: become the finance voice leadership turns to for clarity on performance, strategic trade-offs, and the decisions that define how the business grows
* Leverage AI and drive process improvements: identify areas to automate, accelerate, and sharpen the work across the team

**What you’ll bring:**

* 4-year degree in a relevant field with strong academic performance
* 3–5+ years in FP&A, strategic finance, or a related analytical role preferably at a high growth technology company
* Experience in financial modeling and strategic business planning, including the creation and execution of robust financial plans
* Comfortable solving problems and operating with autonomy in a fast-moving ambiguous environment
* Strong understanding of FP&A fundamentals (variance analysis, variance storytelling, budgeting, forecasting, headcount management, reporting)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to both finance and non-finance audiences
* AI-forward - you actively use AI tools to work faster and go deeper

**Be Human With Us:**  
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.

These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

**What We Offer:**

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

* **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
* **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior Financial Analyst

**Location:** Santa Ana, CA  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Location:** On site

ZenRiva Capital Holdings is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to provide the analysis, reporting, and financial insight that support sound investment and business decisions.

This is not a purely reporting-focused role. You will be expected to understand the story behind the numbers, challenge assumptions, and give senior stakeholders a clear view of performance, risk, and opportunity.

How you will contribute

You will work closely with finance leadership and operational stakeholders on planning, forecasting, investment analysis, and portfolio reporting. The role requires strong technical ability, but also the judgement to know what matters most in a decision.

Your work will include:

* Build and maintain financial models for forecasting, budgeting, investment evaluation, and scenario planning.
* Analyse actual results against budget, forecast, and prior periods, explaining significant movements and key performance drivers.
* Support monthly and quarterly management reporting, including income statements, cash flow, balance-sheet analysis, and variance commentary.
* Prepare financial materials for leadership reviews, investment discussions, and strategic planning.
* Review business cases, capital requests, and investment opportunities, including return analysis and sensitivity testing.
* Partner with operational teams to improve the quality of financial inputs, assumptions, and performance reporting.
* Identify reporting improvements, process gaps, and opportunities to strengthen financial controls.
* Assist with annual budgeting and rolling forecast cycles.
* Support due diligence, data-room preparation, and financial analysis connected with new initiatives or portfolio activity.
* Maintain accurate model documentation, data sources, and supporting analysis.

What you will bring

* Five or more years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, corporate finance, investment analysis, transaction advisory, or a related field.
* Advanced Excel skills and the ability to build clear, reliable financial models from the ground up.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, cash flow, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Experience presenting financial findings to senior leaders or non-finance stakeholders.
* A high level of accuracy, curiosity, and confidence working with incomplete or changing information.
* Strong written communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise financial commentary and executive-ready materials.
* Experience with financial reporting systems, ERP platforms, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
* A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field.

An MBA, CPA, CFA, or progress toward a relevant professional qualification would be beneficial.

Benefits

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) plan with employer contribution
* Paid vacation, sick leave, and company holidays
* Life and disability insurance
* Flexible spending account options
* Professional-development support for relevant training and qualifications
* Employee assistance program
* Company-provided equipment

Latham & Watkins is one of the world’s leading global law firms advising the businesses and institutions that drive the global economy. We are the market leaders in major financial and business centers around the world. Our investment in people, commitment to innovation, and focus on the future empower you to build an incredible career and thrive as an exceptional professional in a supportive culture. If you aspire to be the best, and work with the best, this is where you belong.

About the Role:

The Financial Analyst – Pricing is an integral part of Latham’s Global Finance team. This role will be responsible for driving success towards the firm’s goals and objectives by applying financial, analytical, and business support, while performing profitability scenario analysis and broader financial modeling to support firm pricing decisions and key business initiatives. This role will be located in ourGlobal Services Office in Downtown Los Angeles. Please note that this role may be eligible for a flexible working schedule that allows for a hybrid and in-office presence.

* Conducting internal analysis and external industry research on billable rates, fee structures, and pricing trends, utilizing data mining and databases to prepare recurring and ad hoc financial and client metric reports

jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**

‎

Millennium Physician Group is seeking a Financial Analyst to support growth initiatives across mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and organic growth. This role combines financial modeling, performance analysis, and growth reporting to support business decisions.  
  
The Financial Analyst will support the M&A and partnership evaluation process by collecting data from prospective groups and partners, coordinating due diligence, and preparing financial pro formas. The role will also evaluate organic growth opportunities within existing locations, and own recurring reporting on Growth team KPIs and performance. The analyst will provide ad hoc analysis and collaborate with Business Development, Recruiting, Integrations, Information Technology, Value Based Care, and other teams across MPG.

‎

**How will you make an impact & Requirements**

‎

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Related Degree
* 0-2 years of work experience in healthcare (audit, consulting, or a healthcare quantitative field)
* Previous Microsoft Excel modeling experience is required
* Technical know-how is essential
* Experience with SQL is preferred

**Responsibilities**

  

* Partner with prospects to obtain all due diligence information including pulling data from practice management systems/financial systems when necessary
* Prepare preliminary financial models for acquisition targets
* Project manage the pre-LOI diligence process, including tracking required materials, communicating with the field business development team, and following up with target practices to obtain outstanding information
* Analyze organic growth opportunities across existing locations, including trends in patient volume, provider capacity and productivity, and financial performance
* Develop analyses and business cases to assess organic growth initiatives, quantify potential impact, and monitor outcomes against expectations
* Support financial modeling for new strategic initiatives
* Collaborate with teams across the organization to ensure financial models use current, consistent assumptions
* Track post-closing results against pre-deal financial models
* Own recurring growth reporting, including the preparation, validation, and timely distribution of Growth team KPIs, performance dashboards, and leadership reporting
* Analyze growth results against forecasts, plans, and historical trends; identify performance drivers and communicate key findings to Growth leadership

**Key Competencies**

  

* Analysis/Problem Assessment–Securing relevant information and identifying key issues and relationships from a base of information; relating and comparing data from different sources; identifying cause-effect relationships.
* Compassion-The responsibility to put a patient’s or person’s interests first, including the duty not to harm, deliver proper care, and maintain confidentiality.
* Compliance-Employee has satisfactory completed employers required compliance training. Employee can demonstrate an understanding of employers Code of Conduct.
* Communication-Expressing ideas effectively in individual and group situations (including nonverbal communication); adjusting language or terminology to the characteristics and needs of the audience. Good listening skills.
* Individual Leadership/ Influencing-Using appropriate interpersonal styles and methods to inspire and guide individuals (peers, and supervisors) toward goal achievement; modifying behavior to accommodate tasks, situations, and individuals involved.
* Initiative-Making active attempts to influence events to achieve goals; self-starting rather than accepting passively; taking action to achieve goals beyond what is required; being proactive. Practices self-development.
* Integrity-Maintaining and promoting social, ethical, and organizational norms is conducting internal and external business activities.

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Clipboard**
===================

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

**About the Role:**
===================

As a Documents Compliance Analyst, you own the compliance decisions behind whether a healthcare professional is cleared to work: background check disqualifications, credential and risk review, and how new state requirements get implemented. You set the standard the team applies, and you are the named decision-maker when a case is hard. What the law requires is a given. How we meet it is up to you, and you own that call.

This is not a people management role. The work is recurring by design. The same categories of questions arrive every week, alongside state license renewals and reporting that run on a fixed calendar and never finish. Your value is in reaching the same well-reasoned decision every time and documenting your reasoning well enough that others can apply it. You'll work closely with Agents, SMEs, Team Leads, and Legal, none of whom report to you, so your credibility comes from the quality and consistency of your judgment rather than from authority.

You will report to the Head of the Documents Team.

**What you’ll own**
===================

**Judgment and decisions**

* Serve as the named escalation point for background check disqualification decisions
* Make the initial call on agency compliance implementation
* Handle escalations on worker credential verification, including license violations and reprimands
* Decide which questions you resolve and document yourself, and which warrant partnering with Legal

**Written analysis**

* Produce risk analyses in a consistent format: the question, your research, your reasoning, your recommended path.
* Evaluate new state and agency requirements before implementation, quantifying what compliance costs a worker in time, money, and completion rate, and recommending how we implement.
* Build and maintain the decision record that lets other people reach the same conclusion you would

**Recurring compliance operations**

* Own the credential verification audits
* Plan and drive the implementation of high-value requirements, such as continuing education
* State license renewals
* Ongoing state reporting

**Requirements:**
=================

* Bachelor’s degree.
* At least 5 years of professional experience.
* Prior experience in a role where you applied regulations to real decisions. Examples:

  + regulatory or compliance-focused paralegal
  + regulatory compliance specialist
  + legal analyst
  + background screening adjudicator
  + trust and safety or eligibility policy at a marketplace
* Experience interpreting statutes, regulations, or agency guidance and turning them into operational requirements.

**What we’re looking for:**
===========================

* You can reach a defensible decision when documentation is incomplete or unavailable, and you're explicit about what your reasoning rests on.
* You can read complex regulatory material and work out how it applies in practice to a marketplace model.
* You weigh compliance risk against business impact and find the path that meets the requirement without restricting more than it demands.
* You write decision memos and business cases that leadership can act on.
* You build credibility with people who don't report to you.
* You own recurring work with hard deadlines, such as license renewals and state reporting.
* Willingness to maintain overlapping working hours with Eastern and Pacific time (ET/PT).

**Nice to have:**
=================

* Compliance, regulatory, or licensing experience in healthcare, staffing, or another regulated industry.
* Experience at a government or regulatory agency.
* Experience with independent contractor or marketplace models.
* Experience with background check adjudication or adverse action processes.
* Experience with state licensing filings.

**System Requirements**
=======================

* Minimum 15Mbps wired internet connection
* Minimum i5 processor or equivalent
* Minimum 12GB RAM
* Dedicated, quiet working environment
* Reliable power source and backup internet connection

**Quick Note on Scammers:**

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

Compensation Range: $90K - $110K

jobs.title: Packs Buyer
jobs.description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

We're looking for a relationship-driven, detail-oriented Trading Card Buyer to source inventory, build a strong buying network, and own the operational follow-through behind every purchase.

This is a hands-on buying role—not just an administrative position. You'll represent the business at card shows, develop relationships with collectors and dealers, negotiate purchases within established guidelines, and ensure every deal is accurately documented, paid, and reflected in our inventory systems.

The ideal candidate is comfortable making deals face-to-face and equally committed to keeping accurate records behind the scenes.

**What you'll do:**
===================

### **Buying & Relationship Development**

* Travel to card shows and buying events to source inventory and establish new relationships.
* Build and maintain a network of collectors, dealers, and other inventory sources.
* Develop repeat buying opportunities through consistent outreach, follow-up, and reliable deal execution.
* Negotiate purchases within approved budgets and buying parameters, seeking approval for exceptions.
* Track buying opportunities and share market observations that inform purchasing decisions.

### **Deal Execution & Payments**

* Document each purchase, including the seller, cards acquired, agreed pricing, payment terms, and delivery arrangements.
* Coordinate timely payments to sellers and customers for completed, approved deals using Ramp and other approved payment methods.
* Verify payment information and supporting documentation before submitting or releasing payments.
* Track open invoices, outstanding payments, and unresolved deal items through completion.
* Communicate clearly with sellers about payment status, shipping, and any discrepancies.

### **Inventory & Financial Accountability**

* Own the workflow from purchase through inventory intake, ensuring every acquired item has an accurate digital record.
* Maintain inventory details such as player, year, set, card number, variation, grade, certification number where applicable, purchase cost, and storage location.
* Record item-level costs for individual cards and allocate costs across bulk purchases using an agreed methodology.
* Match inventory records to purchase documentation and payment confirmations so every item can be traced back to its acquisition.
* Track inventory in transit, received, stored, sold, returned, or consigned, as applicable.
* Reconcile physical inventory with digital records and investigate missing items, duplicate entries, or incorrect costs.
* Provide organized records to support bookkeeping and ensure purchase totals, payments, and recorded inventory costs agree.

### **Workflow Ownership**

* Keep buying trackers, inventory spreadsheets, and payment records accurate and current.
* Establish repeatable processes for show purchases, seller follow-up, inventory intake, and reconciliation.
* Maintain a clear view of pending shipments, unpaid deals, unlogged inventory, and other outstanding tasks.
* Coordinate with bookkeeping, sales, and fulfillment partners to ensure clean handoffs.
* Identify process improvements that reduce manual work, prevent errors, and help the business scale.

**What you have:**
==================

* Strong knowledge of all trading cards (sports and gaming), including pricing, grading, condition, and market trends.
* Experience buying, selling, or negotiating sports card deals.
* Ability to build trust and maintain productive relationships with collectors and dealers.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly, including weekends for card shows.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and comfort learning inventory and payment platforms.
* Excellent attention to detail, especially when handling money and high-value inventory.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize follow-up, and take ownership of a deal from sourcing through reconciliation.
* Sound judgment, clear communication, and discretion with sensitive business and payment information.

**Preferred:** An established buying network, experience sourcing at card shows, and familiarity with Ramp or similar payment platforms.

**What success looks like:**
============================

* A growing network of reliable sellers and repeat buying opportunities.
* Purchases that align with buying criteria, budgets, and margin targets.
* Sellers paid accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Inventory logged promptly, with complete purchase and cost records.
* Physical inventory, digital records, and financial documentation consistently reconciled.
* Fewer loose ends and less day-to-day follow-up required from leadership.

**Where you'll live:**
======================

* While we prefer candidates based in Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates. #LI-Remote

**Working at PrizePicks:**
==========================

The typical salary range for this position is $95,000 to $100,000. At PrizePicks, we consider your role, level, and where you'll be working when determining our salary ranges. The compensation info you see on our job postings gives you an idea of the starting pay range for the position. Your actual pay within that range will depend on your specific work location, as well as your skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter will be happy to chat more about the specific pay range for your location and how we arrived at it during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance, Corporate FP&A Lead
jobs.description:
**About Factory**
-----------------

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.  
  
We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.  
  
In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

**About the Role**
------------------

Factory is looking for a Corporate FP&A Lead to own how we plan, measure, and tell the story of our financial performance as we scale through our next phase of hyper-growth. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role on a lean finance team - a true thought partner to leadership on our most consequential financial decisions, and a chance to help build the foundations of the function.

You will own the operating model and the planning and forecasting cadences, partner on board and investor materials, and work directly with leadership, Sales, Engineering, and Accounting to turn ambiguity into decision-ready insight. You will also help build an AI-native finance function, using Factory's own tools to automate the work that traditional FP&A teams do by hand.

### **What you will do and achieve**

* Own the company's core planning processes - annual operating plan, long-range plan, quarterly forecasts, and monthly performance reviews
* Own the corporate operating model that underpins planning, scenarios, and strategic decisions
* Lead monthly business reviews with leadership: report results, explain variances, and surface risks and opportunities
* Partner on board and investor materials to help shape the narrative of where the business is headed
* Partner with GTM, Engineering, Operations, and G&A leaders on budgets, headcount, and COGS - bringing a financial perspective to how each org invests
* Model infrastructure and compute economics, and evaluate vendor commitments, pricing, and capital-allocation tradeoffs
* Define, track, and report the KPIs that measure topline performance, unit economics, and operational efficiency
* Partner with Accounting on an accurate, timely close and on budget-vs-actuals - explaining performance, resolving discrepancies, and course-correcting early
* Build scalable FP&A systems, dashboards, and automated reporting that turn raw data into timely, decision-ready insight
* Build AI-native workflows for recurring finance analysis - applying Factory's own tooling to cut manual cycles and unlock deeper analytical work

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 8+ years in corporate FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, or consulting
* Strong technical foundation - three-statement modeling, driver-based modeling, and long-range plans
* Strong command of annual planning, forecasting, budgeting, and monthly and board reporting cadences
* Experience preparing board and investor materials and translating complex data into clear narratives for executives and external stakeholders
* Strong analytical rigor and the judgment to evaluate opportunities, risks, and tradeoffs in the financials
* Fluency in SaaS and usage-based financials - gross margin and COGS, opex and headcount planning, and the metrics that matter to a board
* Comfort with ambiguity and a high-agency, roll-up-your-sleeves mindset in a lean, fast-paced environment
* Able to form a point of view and bring a clear recommendation - weighing trade-offs and communicating them, not just presenting numbers - with strong executive communication and low ego
* Energized by AI-assisted workflows and automation - you build automation into your work rather than waiting for someone else to
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  **Nice to have**
  ----------------

* Experience with financial planning and BI tools (e.g. Pigment, Anaplan)
* Background in AI, ML, or cloud infrastructure economics
* Experience supporting capital raises or IPO readiness
* Fluency translating between GAAP and non-GAAP metrics
* Experience scaling a finance function - and team - through rapid growth

**This is an in-office position (5 days/week) in San Francisco (walking distance to Caltrain)**

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
The Senior Financial Analyst aka Senior Decision Support Analyst is responsible for performing critical application and analysis functions in support of UCSF Health’s Financial Decision Support system. The analyst plays a critical role in maintaining the decision support system to ensure production of high-quality, accurate, and timely patient-level financial and clinical data for our Finance and Operational business partners. The decision support system is the single source of critical financial data that all Operating units, Vice Presidents, and Directors use to prepare ROI analyses for capital and value-improvement projects, develop case-based budgets, and provide program and service-line profitability reporting.

Responsibilities will include developing business cases and extracting cost, billing, patient demographic, and other information from the Health System cost accounting database and various dashboards and Business/Clinical Intelligence tools. A critical component of this position is the ability to establish effective working relationships with staff who have a deep understanding of UCSF IT applications and databases to develop the knowledge needed to analyze complex data sets.

Supports the Director – Shared Service in their overall strategy to achieve best practices in the management of the decision support system, and its associated reporting tools. To accomplish this, the Senior analyst must develop and maintain key relationships with other Financial and IT professionals.

  

Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in a related area or HS Diploma/GED and four years of equivalent experience/training.
* Five or more years of experience in Decision Support or Financial Management in the Healthcare field, preferably in a hospital setting.
* Experience with hospital cost accounting concepts and systems, specifically Strata or EPSi, as well as a solid understanding of hospital and professional patient billing data, including healthcare reimbursement principles. Additionally, experience with Strata/EPSi cost accounting and decision support systems is required.
* Knowledge of and experience working with healthcare specific EMR, Decision Support, and financial accounting software. (e.g. Epic, Strata/EPSi, Oracle or similar).
* Advanced data management and mining skills include ability to develop and execute highly complex SQL queries and stored procedures to organize, transform and extract financial and clinical data for production of relevant, meaningful reports, statistics, analyses and forecasts.
* Advanced interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead projects and teams and collaborate productively on highly complex projects with key personnel at all professional and technical levels.
* Advanced written and verbal communications skills, with the ability to interpret and convey highly sophisticated technical and financial information in a clear, concise manner, and to make cogent presentations of analyses, reports, and investigation results.
* Advanced problem-solving skills analytical ability, and in-depth knowledge of documentation and reporting, with the ability to run highly complex queries and studies, to collect and analyze financial and performance data, and to produce relevant, meaningful reports, analyses, and forecasts.
* In-depth ability to work with senior staff and managers across departments, serving as a technical leader and information resource in decision support, and providing recommendations and advice on decision support processes, business and financial issues, and industry trends and advances.
* The ability to work onsite in San Francisco when required.

Preferences:

* Advanced excel and power point skills.

jobs.title: Program Analyst
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

This position is located at the San Francisco VA Health Care System (SFVAHCS) in San Francisco, CA. The primary purpose of this position is to provide advanced administrative, analytic, and application coordination support for the Surgical Service.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

  

**Duties**
----------

\*\***\*THIS IS NOT A VIRTUAL POSITION, YOU MUST LIVE WITHIN OR BE WILLING TO RELOCATE WITHIN A COMMUTABLE DISTANCE OF THE DUTY LOCATION\*\*\***
  
  
**PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS - 50%**

* Monitor and provide overall analysis of the Surgical Service performance measures by utilizing databases
* Compiles data into Power Point presentations
* Track completion of these measures reporting to leadership
* Oversee a variety of administrative programs
* Develop standard operating procedures/SOP and correspondence

**ORGANIZATIONAL ANALYSIS - 25%**

* Conduct studies and evaluate operation needs of surgical service
* Review data, summarize information, propose, and implement changes based on finds
* Perform a variety of analysis regarding correspondences from outside federal agencies
* Serve as an expert in ADPAC- Automated Data Processing Application Coordinator duties
* Serve as liaison between service and Office of Information and Technology

**COMPLIANCE AND CREDENTIALING - 20%**

* Work with Medical Staff Office to initiate credentialing paperwork
* Assist with maintaining employee files and completing six-month evaluations
* Maintain Surgical Service's policies and procedures

**SPACE/EQUIPMENT PROCUREMENT - 5%**

* Work with the Surgical Business Manager to coordinate the assignment and the use of Surgical Service space
* Conduct studies to identify the function of the area
* Perform office management, evaluation of surgical service policies and procedures
* Work with Interior Designer and IT to prepare and submit requests for new furniture and correspondence workstation installation
* Order equipment and maintain inventory

**Work Schedule:** Monday - Friday - 8:00AM - 4:30PM
  
**Recruitment & Relocation Incentives:** Not authorized
  
**Telework -** This position may be eligible for Telework-Ad-Hoc

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job
* **To be considered for this position, you must complete all required steps in the process.** In addition to the application and questionnaire, this position requires an online assessment. The online assessment measures critical general competencies required to perform the job.
* Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959
* Physical Requirements: The work is sedentary. It occasionally requires carrying objects such as files, books and papers; some walking, standing and bending. No special physical qualifications are required. The work is typically performed in an office setting..
* Subject to background/security investigation
* Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process. Acceptable form(s) of identification will be required to complete pre-employment requirements (https://www.uscis.gov/i-9-central/form-i-9-acceptable-documents). Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state-issued identification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment.
* Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP) - See "Required Documents" below for details.

As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1-year probationary period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider:

* your performance and conduct;
* the needs and interests of the agency;
* whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and
* whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service.

Upon completion of your probationary, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

### **Qualifications**

**To be eligible for this position you must have one of the following:**
  
  
EXPERIENCE: Possess one year of specialized experience that equipped you with the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of this position, and that is typically in or related to the position. To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the GS-07 grade level. Specialized experience includes having applied analytical and evaluative methods and techniques to issues or studies concerning the efficiency and effectiveness of a clinical program; assisted with the development and maintenance of a quality improvement and/or performance plan to include data collection and appraisal of effectiveness of clinical activity, as well as, analyzing and reporting findings to management having planned, organized, and developed studies or projects, made recommendations on operating programs and negotiated with others to accept and implement recommendations; having evaluated and made recommendations regarding health care delivery systems, maintained budget information, and status funds. This experience must be detailed in your resume to receive credit.
  
**OR**
  
**EDUCATION SUBSTITUTION:** Possess a master's or equivalent graduate degree, 2 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree, or an LL.B. or J.D., in a related field that provided the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work of this position.

jobs.description:

-----------

Employee will be assigned to Facilities Management Service, Project Development Section, VA Healthcare System, Palo Alto, CA. The primary purpose of this position is to plan, coordinate, and execute all building and space activation, transition, and deactivation activities across the campus. The position also supports capital asset planning and manages space assignments and project management for capital construction projects to optimize utilization and align facilities with strategic goals.

Learn more about this agency

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

At the GS-11 grade level, you will perform assignments of a more limited scope and with less independence. jobs.title: Cost Analyst – Construction
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**

**Turner & Townsend** is seeking a **Cost Analyst** to support large-scale construction programs in the San José, CA market. The ideal candidate will be responsible for cost reporting, installation and productivity analysis, data analytics, and dashboard development, providing insights into cost performance across multiple capital projects. This role will support project controls, cost management, and reporting efforts throughout the construction lifecycle, enabling data-driven decision-making for project teams and stakeholders.  
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Inform the client of product cost performance using data from multiple projects across a global program
* Develop presentations & narratives of product cost performance across projects
* Develop and maintain databases and reporting dashboards.
* Develop and maintain data models and governance processes.
* Presentation to clients and internal teams of developed dashboards & analyses.
* Create processes and structure to support the “way of working”.
* Support the training of regional personnel and clients.
* Present high-level metrics in a simple, accessible way.
* SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Strong analytical skills and technical skills (statistical analysis, scientific method, organization, problem solving).
* B.S. in STEM field of study.
* Minimum 2 years’ work-related work experience.
* Familiarity with common computational languages used in data analytics (SQL, Python, Google Sheets, MS Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Data Studio, etc.).
* Ability to understand key cost drivers & different specialty trades.
* Experience working in the construction industry is required.
* Experience in data management and deep dive analysis.
* At minimum has a basic understanding of SQL queries and methodology to report data to project teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft and Google Suite of applications.
* Experience with client specific systems.
* Ability to coordinate & organize multiple sources of performance data.
* Ability to build data models to support required analysis and reporting.
* Vision and design flare to translate data to best practice data visualization.
* Openness and interest to learn new data analysis & reporting.
* Advanced skills with spreadsheets, charts, and presentations.
* Ability to develop good working relationships within different client cultures and across multiple project teams.
* Good organization skills, ability to multi-task, prioritize, and be a team player.
* Drive to be proactive and self-motivated.
* Advanced presentation skills and ability to thrive in a client-facing role.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* The tenacity and ambition inject value and create solutions.

  
**Additional Information**

* ***On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.***

The base salary range for this role is $95K-$105K USD. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and www.heery.com/

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
The Financial Analyst provides technical and operational support to accounting, finance, and commercial teams. Supports month-end activities, including analyzing and reconciling budget and expenses, and assists the VP of Finance on various projects.

**Essential Functions and Main Duties**

* FP&A business partner for commercial organization, including monthly actual vs budget/forecast reviews, quarterly forecast updates, budget process, FP&A special projects / Ad hoc analysis
* Communicate with and respond to internal Sales team regarding their sales incentive plans.
* Update forecast of monthly gross margins based on sales orders and projects
* Support Sales team on analyzing customer performance and potential new business, including gross margin analysis for deals
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to track necessary KPIs relevant to the business
* Partner with sales leadership and marketing team to develop financial models and forecasts for potential new business promotions or programs to support the growth of order volume
* Support the annual development of sales incentive plans with Finance team and Sr. VP of Sales
* Improve financial models and reporting templates to summarize KPIs and create efficiency for team
* Demonstrate a high level of intellectual curiosity with ad-hoc projects to identify opportunities to reduce expenses and drive more profit growth
* Seek opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting systems, automate reports
* Provide support for month-end activities, including accruals, reconciliation of B/S accounts,
* Assist in monthly reporting for NKA’s Sales team to track performance and determine commissions earned based on customer orders, shipments, and payments
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and business ethics codes.
* Duties may be modified or assigned at any time based on business need.

**Qualifications**

**Education / Certification / Experience required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or related discipline; relevant education and experience accepted in lieu of degree
* 2+ years of experience in forecasting, finance, and accounting
* Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems preferred
* High level of competency in Excel, Powerpoint, other Office related tools
* Level and compensation depend on location, experience, education and skills

**Competencies Required:**

* Strong analytical, problem solving, and organizational skills
* High level of attention to detail
* Ability to coordinate multiple tasks, set priorities, and meet deadlines
* Ability to synthesize information and make recommendations
* Ability to interact effectively cross-functionally and with senior leadership
* Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Must be able to communicate verbally and in writing, and to receive and understand verbal and written instructions in English
* Able to work effectively both independently and in a collaborative team environment

**Working Conditions**

**Schedule:** The regular hours for this full-time position are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday–Friday, unless otherwise stated by the department manager. Holiday, weekend, and evening work hours may be required. Regular hours may vary due to the needs of the organization or department and are subject to change at any time at the Company’s discretion.

**Physical:** Generally may require some reaching, bending, stooping, squatting, crawling, kneeling, pushing, pulling, lifting, carrying up to 20 pounds, finger dexterity, repetitive motions, standing, walking, sitting, hearing, visual acuity, color vision, and 2-way written/verbal communication in English. More specific details may be provided as needed or requested.

**Travel:** Not Required

**Access to Customer Sites:** Not Required

**Compensation**

The anticipated range for this position is $80,000 - $110,000. Actual placement within the range is dependent on multiple factors, including but not limited to skills, education, experience and location.

**Perks and Benefits**

Visit our Career page to learn more about Perks & Benefits and working at Nihon Kohden America

jobs.title: FP&A Controller, Laboratory Solutions - Remote
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Join our team now at Siemens Healthineers as Financial Controller, Core Lab. In this role you will be a key member of the NAM Business Line Finance function, supporting the day to day operations of the business, forecast preparation, financial analysis, reporting on leading and lagging indicators, tracking and driving progress towards financial and business goals, meeting preparation, and supporting the continued digitalization of our business reporting and other special topics.

**As an FP&A Controller, Laboratory Solutions, you will be responsible for**:

**Business Performance Analysis and Partnership**

* Perform analysis of business/financial performance, identifying key customer trends and providing appropriate commentary
* Prepare executive level reports and presentations including the development and maintenance of executive dashboards

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Service, Commercial Excellence, and Finance stakeholders to guide the financial success of the assigned North American Instrument/Reagent Segments
* Analyze revenue, profit, and key business drivers to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into actionable recommendations for Finance and business leadership
* Support monthly performance reviews and executive discussions by preparing scorecards, management commentary, variance analysis, and recommendations that connect financial results with commercial and operational performance

**Planning and Forecasting**

* Assist with budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis of the Lab Diagnostics, North America, Instrument/Reagent Segments

* Maintain and update planning models, tools and processes to reflect current and future changes to the business as new information is acquired
* Prepare and maintain monthly forecasts and annual planning analyses for revenue and profit, including variance bridges and clear explanations of changes versus budget, prior forecast, and prior year
* Maintain a structured view of financial risks and opportunities, coordinating inputs across functions, and support timely corrective actions to improve forecast accuracy and delivery against financial commitments

**Digital Finance**

* Shape digitalization for the future within the business by leveraging dashboards, apps and reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, SQL)
* Automate recurring reporting, forecast, and performance-management activities to improve efficiency and consistency, and the speed of insight delivery
* Maintain data quality and control standards across dashboards and analytical tools, documenting methodologies, and partnering with stakeholders to create scalable, user-focused reporting solutions

**This position may suit you best if you are familiar with what is below, and would like to develop your career with Healthineers**

* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, especially MS Excel Power Point skills, SAP or an equivalent ERP system
* Ability or willingness to learn and leverage PowerBi, Tableau, KNIME etc.
* Strong financial understanding: P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Financial Processes, IFRS/GAAP
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact appropriately with all levels of the organization
* Demonstrated ownership and accountability
* Proven ability to manage projects/tasks to ensure timely delivery with high-quality results
* Experience with digitalization and business process improvement
* Self-driven and resourceful to ensure that deadlines are met

**Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience:**

  

* Bachelors Degree in Finance/Accounting/Business and or related area(s)
* 5+ years of successful experience in a directly related field and successful demonstration of key responsibilities and knowledge

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work:** When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Siemens Healthineers businesses, please visit our company page here.

$118,090 - $162,371

jobs.title: Cost Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Cost Analyst supports the Sr. Plant Controller by preparing, analyzing, and maintaining accurate cost accounting, inventory, and manufacturing financial information. This position assists with month-end close, standard costing, cost roll activities, inventory valuation, variance analysis, reporting, and process improvement. The role is responsible for producing timely and reliable financial data, investigating cost drivers, supporting cross-functional business partners, and helping improve the accuracy, efficiency, and consistency of cost accounting processes across the organization.

**Responsibilities: Essential Duties**

* Support month-end close activities, including review and correction of production orders, recording of COGS and WIP activity, and analysis of production order variances.
* Prepare weekly and monthly inventory reporting and assist with inventory valuation, reserve analysis, and reconciliation activities.
* Calculate and maintain excess and obsolete inventory reserves in accordance with company policy and accounting requirements.

jobs.description:
***Please Note:*** *To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.*

This position is with **Jariet Technologies, Inc.**, a subsidiary of CesiumAstro. Jariet is developing breakthrough technologies to permit digital communications technology to be applied at micro/mm-Wave speeds using standard CMOS processes. Jariet is well positioned to provide ASIC products into emerging markets in multi-antenna beamforming communications systems and wireless infrastructure as well as digital deployments into microwave point-to-point links and radar systems. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a **Senior** **Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Analyst** to our team. The position will be based in Redondo Beach, CA and will be supporting our subsidiary, Jariet Technologies. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about making an impact in a growing company, we would like to hear from you.

In this position, you will play a key role in supporting the overall financial health and direction of the company while simultaneously focusing on foundational business operations. You will be responsible for preparing budgets, developing forecasts, performing variance analyses, and project finance modeling. You will have the ability to affect change and collaborate with the entire team to exponentially grow both Jariet Technologies and Cesium Astro. Your contributions will play an essential role in supporting the companies through hyper-growth as you forecast the future while scaling both revenue and internal relationships.

### **JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Creating, updating, and maintaining financial models and detailed forecasts of future operations.
* Comparing historical results against budgets and forecasts, and performing variance analyses to explain differences in performance and make improvements going forward.
* Working closely with the Cesium Astro Finance Team, meeting their deadlines and responding to questions.
* Researching key financial ratios of industry peers and benchmarking company data.
* Evaluating company financial data to ensure investments are the best use of capital by looking at return on investment (ROI) and comparisons with other ways the company could utilize cash.
* Leading program budgets/baseline controls, earned value management systems (EVMS), and ensuring all required finance inputs, including internal and external reporting, are prepared, reviewed, and submitted on time.
* Evaluating potential program and product opportunities to determine costs and profitability.
* Building out support processes for proposals that include, but are not limited to, developing cost volumes, basis of estimates (BOEs), and roll-ups of non-recurring efforts (NREs), recurring efforts (REs), and materials.
* Evaluating financials for each department and working with individual departments to prepare budgets and forecasts and consolidate into corporate budgets and forecasts.
* Preparing internal reports for executive leadership to support decision-making.
* Evaluating inorganic growth opportunities and mapping out capital and investment plans.
* Generating three- to five-year financial forecasts.
* Extracting Big Data sets and consolidating into useful analytics.
* Developing dashboards and key metrics to track the business and inform strategy.

### **JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* A bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance from an accredited university or college.
* 5+ years of financial planning experience, ideally working in a fast-paced environment and meeting tight deadlines.
* Must be willing to work at or relocate to our Redondo Beach location, as this is an in-office position.
* Experience developing and implementing financial budgets and forecasts.

**Karman Industries**

Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Gardena, California, Karman Industries is at the forefront of revolutionizing industrial thermal energy. Our mission is to electrify global thermal systems across data centers, manufacturing, and energy industries. Karman is developing the revolutionary Heat Processing Unit (HPU) to reinvent thermal handling for giga-scale data centers & AI factories. The HPU is built around a supercritical CO2 chiller system utilizing a high-speed electrically driven turbomachinery core. Our system aims to reduce energy consumption in data center thermal management by greater than 25% and increase energy density by 10x.

* Ability to read BOMs, datasheets, mechanical drawings, and basic schematics, including motor and power-module datasheets (voltage, current, losses, thermal limits, insulation class)

* Experience with ERP/MRP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar), including planning and purchasing modules, and advanced Excel skills
* Working knowledge of import and export basics: customs, tariffs, Incoterms, and country-of-origin documentation

jobs.title: Senior Buyer / Global Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Foundry Robotics is building an AI-native robotics manufacturing company focused on deploying advanced assembly and production capability for leading robotics companies and national-security-critical hardware. Basically, we're building robots that build robots.  
  
We are reimagining manufacturing through advanced robotics. Our mission is to rebuild the American manufacturing industry as an AI-first, assembly-focused, dual-use contract manufacturer. We aim to empower manufacturers with intelligent, efficient, and adaptable robotic systems that redefine productivity and quality. As a senior leader on our manufacturing team, you will have a direct and significant impact on our product, culture, and ultimate success. This role is 100% in-person at our office in Emeryville, CA.

**The role**
------------

You will own procurement end to end, from placing purchase orders on Monday to building the supplier base we'll need over the next two years. This is a hybrid role where you'll manage day-to-day purchasing for active customer programs while developing the sourcing strategies, supplier network, and processes we need to scale.

* **Buyer side (execution):** turn customer BOMs into on-time, conforming material for every build, often for new products launched in weeks, not quarters.
* **GSM side (strategy):** qualify and develop a domestic-first, defense-ready supplier base; negotiate agreements; manage risk, cost and AS9100 supplier controls.

You'll be one of the first supply chain hires, working directly with production, quality, program management and our customers' engineering teams.  
  
**Founder mentality:** We love people who build like it’s their own company. You move fast, take ownership, and find a way through when the path isn’t obvious. You have the drive to make big things happen and the judgment to take smart risks along the way. If you prefer a clearly defined lane, a predictable pace, and all the answers before you start, there’s nothing wrong with that—but Foundry might not be the right fit.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Procurement and execution**

  + Own purchasing for high-mix, low-volume electromechanical builds: electronics, cable and harness, machined and sheet-metal parts, fasteners, motors, sensors and consumables.
  + Convert customer BOMs and quotes into purchase orders with complete requirements and flow-downs (quality clauses, DFARS/ITAR, certs, FAI, special processes).
  + Run expedites, shortages and allocation calls so NPI and production builds start on schedule.
  + Manage customer-furnished material and customer-directed suppliers alongside our own buys.
  + Maintain accurate purchasing data in our ERP: lead times, pricing, approved sources, open PO status.
* **Strategic sourcing and supplier management**

  + Build and maintain the Approved Supplier List; evaluate, qualify and onboard new suppliers per our AS9100 Purchasing procedure.
  + Develop a domestic and allied-nation supply base that supports defense customers and onshoring goals.
  + Negotiate pricing, LTAs, blanket orders, consignment and VMI programs that support both speed and cost.
  + Track supplier performance (OTD, quality, responsiveness) and report it at Management Review; drive SCARs with Quality.
  + Identify single-source, obsolescence and geopolitical risks early and stand up alternates.
* **Quality and compliance**

  + Prevent counterfeit parts: buy from authorized channels and enforce traceability and C of C requirements.
  + Partner with the Head of Quality on supplier audits, source inspection and nonconformance disposition.
  + Ensure compliance with ITAR/EAR, DFARS specialty-metals and cybersecurity flow-downs, and country-of-origin rules.

**Scaling the function**

* Help select and configure procurement tools, MRP logic and supplier portals as we grow.
* Feed DFM and quoting with real cost and lead-time data, and flag long-lead or hard-to-source parts during quote review.
* Support the supply plan for our new factory build-out, including robotic cell components and capital equipment.
* Write the playbooks and mentor future buyers and planners.

**What We're Looking for**
--------------------------

* 7+ years in procurement, purchasing or supply management for electromechanical hardware, with at least 3 years in a senior buyer, commodity manager or supply manager role.
* Experience in a contract manufacturer (EMS/CM) or high-mix, low-volume production environment.
* Hands-on buying across multiple commodities: electronic components, PCBAs, cable/harness, machined and sheet-metal parts.
* Working knowledge of AS9100 or ISO 9001 purchasing requirements: supplier approval, flow-downs, FAI, traceability and counterfeit-parts prevention.
* Familiarity with ITAR/EAR and DFARS requirements, and willingness to work on export-controlled programs. U.S. person status required (ITAR).
* Proven negotiation results on price, lead time and terms, plus experience building supplier relationships from scratch.
* Strong ERP/MRP skills (e.g., NetSuite, Odoo, Epicor or similar) and advanced spreadsheet skills.
* Comfort reading engineering drawings and BOMs and talking specs with engineers.
* Bias for action: you thrive with ambiguity, own outcomes, and move fast without cutting quality corners.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, robotics, medical device or autonomy hardware.
* Background building a supply chain function at an early-stage startup or a new factory.
* Established network of domestic machine shops, harness houses, PCBA suppliers and authorized distributors.
* Experience sourcing robotics and automation components (servos, actuators, cameras, grippers, industrial PCs) or capital equipment.
* Knowledge of DFARS 252.225 specialty metals, 252.246-7007/7008 counterfeit-part rules, NIST 800-171/CMMC flow-downs, and Buy American / TAA.
* Component obsolescence and lifecycle management (e.g., SiliconExpert, Z2Data).
*

The ERP Testing & Billing Analyst supports the Oracle ERP implementation with a focused emphasis on UAT and Parallel Testing for business billing scenarios, and partners with Billing, Accounts Receivable, Payroll, Operations, IT, and ERP project resources to document business scenarios, execute test scripts, validate billing outputs, identify defects, support issue resolution, and help ensure business readiness for go-live.

* Billing Validation: Review billing calculations, customer invoice outputs, contract/project billing scenarios, adjustments, and downstream impacts to AR and reporting to confirm accuracy and completeness.

* Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, finance, information technology, healthcare administration, or a related field is desired.
* 2+ years of billing, revenue operations, ERP, finance operations, project accounting, staffing operations, or related business process experience is desired.
* 2-5 years’ experience supporting UAT, Parallel Testing, system implementation, billing validation, or operational readiness activities required.
* Oracle ERP, Oracle Fusion, PPM, Contracts, or Project Billing exposure is a plus but not required.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to review detailed billing outputs, identify variances, research root causes, and document findings clearly.
* Proficiency with Excel and comfort working with testing trackers, issue logs, shared files, and project management tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate business issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Exceptional organization, diligence, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple testing priorities in a fast-paced project environment.
* Familiarity with the staffing industry, preferably within the healthcare sector, is highly desirable.

Company equipment(laptop, monitor, keyboard, mouse headset) will be provided directly to you for use during employment.

**Vendor workforce governance**

* Measure staffed hours delivered by each vendor against the locked requirement, by week and interval, using Genesys data.
* Enforce the SOW's workforce terms: interval staffing floor, billable hours cap, efficiency floor, adherence target, flex notices and overtime pre-authorization.
* Reconcile invoiced payroll hours against Genesys login hours monthly, and document variances and credits owed.
* Own the workforce measures in the joint vendor scorecard, and prepare workforce content for weekly reviews, monthly performance reviews and QBRs.
* Track vendor attrition, ramp and hiring-wave delivery against plan.

* Design the business unit and management unit structure (one unit per vendor), with adherence rules and permissions for each.

* Ensure every vendor's schedules exist in Genesys, built there or imported, so adherence is measured on Matrix's platform.
* Own adherence, shrinkage and staffed-hours reporting from Genesys.
* Use Genesys forecasting and capacity planning for inbound work such as member callbacks.

**Outbound campaign strategy**

* Decide list segmentation and allocation by vendor and campaign. Each contact list runs on one campaign at a time, so list allocation is the main lever for splitting volume.
* Set dialing mode, calling windows by member time zone, abandon-rate thresholds and attempt cadence within Matrix's dialer rules, including the 20-attempt annual cap.
* Partner with telecom on caller ID and attestation to protect contact rate.
* Genesys administrators carry out configuration changes; this role decides them.

**Daily allocation and channel monitoring**

* Review prior-day performance by source: contact rate, acceptance rate, LCPH, scheduled and completed visits.
* Make same-day list and hours adjustments within the decision rights below.
* Watch disposition trends for signs that a model input has drifted.
* Track text, IVR and print response as inputs to voice hours, and as scope expands, recommend channel-mix shifts.

* Build and maintain the vendor scorecard and capacity dashboards in Power BI.
* Produce a monthly capacity outlook and channel performance summary with explicit recommendations.

* Evaluating financials for each department and working with individual departments to prepare budgets and forecasts and consolidate into corporate budgets and forecasts.
* Preparing internal reports for executive leadership to support decision-making.
* Evaluating inorganic growth opportunities and mapping out capital and investment plans.
* Generating three- to five-year financial forecasts.
* Extracting Big Data sets and consolidating into useful analytics.
* Developing dashboards and key metrics to track the business and inform strategy.

### **JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* A bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance from an accredited university or college.

**Broadata Communications, Inc. (BCI) – Torrance, CA**  
*On-site*  
**Company Overview**  
**Broadata Communications, Inc. (BCI)** is a privately held California-based corporation. BCI is a leading and innovative company specializing in the development of market-driven products for the transmission of digital multimedia (video, audio, and data) over fiber. Our clients are world leaders in their industries, spanning entertainment, broadcast, medical, professional audio/video, house of worship, education, government, military, and transportation sectors.  
This is a critical, hands-on role in supply chain and operations, located in Torrance, CA. We offer a dynamic, fast-paced, high impact and stimulating work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development within BCI. Veterans welcome!  
**JOB SUMMARY**  
The **Buyer** is responsible for coordinating and initiating the timely release of purchase orders as well as negotiating contracts for production materials and supporting all stages of product development, working with engineers and manufacturing personnel. Coordinate competitive procurements to meet required purchase dates and prepare required supporting documentation. The successful candidate will play a critical role in the Corporation’s success, ensuring that we continually meet required production schedules as well as managing end-to-end materials procurement for internal developments.  
  
This is a hands-on position. This is NOT a remote or hybrid position.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze current orders, historical data, and other records to determine the best source. Identify and recommend suppliers by investigating potential suppliers, researching parts, equipment, machinery, services, and materials availability.
* May conduct supplier site visits and evaluate them as to production capability, performance, delivery, and other key business criteria. May complete supplier certification as part of a technical and/or quality team.
* Purchases parts, equipment, and materials by preparing request for quotations and submitting purchase orders with approved suppliers. Issue purchase orders and agreements, that accurately reflect price, schedule, terms, and conditions as negotiated with suppliers. Familiarity with AS9100 Quality Systems is a plus.
* Select suppliers for lower cost items or items of limited scope and complexity and negotiate price, delivery, quality and service. Develop alternate sources of supply by identifying and researching prospective suppliers.
* Monitor and evaluate supplier performance. Advises appropriate personnel of impending supplier failure to fulfill contractual agreements that may delay production or delivery. Resolve shipment quality discrepancies by mediating supplier/manufacturing issues. Facilitate the resolution of issues by arranging and participating in conferences between suppliers and company personnel.
* Negotiate and settle damage claims, rejections, losses, return of materials, over-shipments, cancellations, invoice discrepancies and engineering changes with suppliers. Problem solving as needed.
* Advise supervisor when rescheduling is necessary. Follow up, expedite, and negotiate changes relative to delivery and supplier performance.
* Maximize the value of each purchase with the Company's requirements and policies to achieve balance between function, productivity, quality, and other terms with suppliers and various internal departments.
* Maintain professional relationships with internal and external customers and suppliers.
* Fast-paced, efficient, driven to meet targets – success is determined by placement speed, ability to resolve problems, accuracy/compliance of procurement packages, and cost savings.
* Experience in supply chain, purchasing, production planning, compliance is a plus!
* Other duties and special projects as assigned.

This list is intended to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification and is not designed to be interpreted as an exhaustive listing of all tasks required of employees assigned to this job.  
  
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree 1 - 2 years of experience
* **or** Associate’s degree, with 3 - 4 years of relevant experience
* Certifications from Industry associations is a plus (C.P.M.)
* Experience in high-tech manufacturing/ production environment a plus
* Understanding and hands-on experience with manufacturing resource planning (MRP) systems such as SAGE, NetSuite or equivalent a plus.

**Skills & Abilities**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products, such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Ability to commit and work under deadlines
* Strong mathematical and analytical skills; demonstrated proficiency working with large data sets
* Must be able to work in a challenging and engaging work environment that promotes teamwork, creativity, accountability, and professional development.
* Willingness and demonstrated ability to self-learn and work in new technology domains.
* Highly self-motivated.

**Physical Job Requirements**  
The employee in the position will be required to occasionally move throughout the facilities, including climbing stairs, when necessary. Occasional bending and reaching in an office environment, including opening and closing file cabinets drawers with light grasping. Type on a standard keyboard (laptop or desktop). Use standard computer display screens. Use standard push-button phones and must speak clearly and be understood by others. Sit or stand in a standard upright position for a minimum of one hour, but up to 12 hours a day. Be able to lift and carry weight unassisted not exceeding 50 lbs.

**What will you do?**

A day in the life of a Sr. Financial Analyst (DTC) at Vans looks a little like this.

Reporting to the DTC Finance Manager, you will be a trusted finance partner to Americas DTC leadership, owning business performance analysis, reporting, and forecasting to support the channel. The Sr. Financial Analyst will also be responsible for supporting the development and implementation of the annual budget, the strategic plan, and analysis & reporting of monthly operating results. In order to succeed, this individual will leverage leadership and communication skills, advanced knowledge of financial systems and sharp business judgement. The position requires strong attention to detail and trend recognition, with the ability to monitor performance to inform business decisions.

**Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.**

* Support the monthly forecast, reporting and analysis, the annual operating plan, and the strategic plan processes.
* Maintain and develop financial models and analysis to support strategic initiatives.
* Track and analyze Actuals vs Budget/Forecast for Sales & Margin of the Americas DTC channel.
* Own the KPI reporting and forecasting for Stores and Ecommerce, translating results into clear insights and recommendations for Senior Leadership.
* Drive automation and enhancements in financial reporting and analysis.
* Lead ad hoc analyses and special projects that shape Store, and Ecommerce business decisions.

We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 3+ years of experience and professional achievements.

**What do you need to succeed?**

* The foundation skills you will need in this position are:
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or other quantitative/analytical disciplines. An MBA is a plus but not a requirement.
* 3-5 years of FP&A or corporate finance experience, preferably in retail or consumer-related industries.
* Excellent Excel, PowerPoint, data management and reporting skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks in a dynamic environment & to be a team player.
* Knowledge and experience in financial concepts, budgeting, and forecasting with strong financial modeling skills.
* Detail-oriented with exceptional analytical skills.
* Ability to partner across functions and drive process improvements and business results.
* Strong analytical skills – advanced analysis and critical thinking skills which would enable thoughtful analysis and interpretation of financial results and identification of key business issues underlying the numbers.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to communicate complex ideas in a simple way.
* Experience with ERP systems and financial reporting tools.
