new_jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
new_jobs.description:
I magine how your ideas and expertise can change a patient’s life. Patients are at the heart of what we do at Edwards Lifesciences. Our Finance teams work hard to optimize our current and long-term success and enable our ongoing strategy of innovation, leadership, and focus. As part of the team, whether providing analysis, forecasting, or reporting financial information, your application of accurate financial business practices will play a fundamental role in how we impact the quality of life for patients all over the world.

  

Patients with mitral and tricuspid heart valve disease often have complex conditions with limited treatment options. Our Transcatheter Mitral and Tricuspid Therapies (TMTT) business unit is boldly pursuing an innovative portfolio of technologies to address a patient’s unmet clinical needs. It’s our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey.

**How you’ll make an impact:**

  

* Planning – Advise Cost Center managers to generate complex solutions to obtaining necessary resources within budgetary constraints, including identifying opportunities and mitigating risks (e.g., cost center planning, revenue planning, reporting)
* Business Reporting and Analysis – Assess complex report data (e.g., month-end matrix report, quarter-end year-over-year sequence reporting, headcount reporting, trend analysis, planned and forecast variance analysis) to identify opportunities for course correction/course alignment, including writing justification for variances
* Month-End Close – Manage cost center finances including journal entries, review financial measures, provide guidance and advice regarding cost center performance, and develop BU specific reports (e.g., commission support, customer rebates)
* Special Projects – Varying duties by business unit, e.g., developing trend analysis and mix analysis on gross profit, sales operations, clinical contract management
* Compliance – Ensure Edwards compliance by applying knowledge of applicable regulations (e.g., Sunshine Act, SOX, GAAP financials, SEC, IRS) to develop explanations for internal and external auditors
* Other incidental duties
  

  

**What you'll need (Required):**

* Bachelor's Degree in Finance or Accounting
* A minimum of five years of previous related experience or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria
  

  

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

  

* Experience working in financial planning and analysis (FP&A)
* Proven expertise in MS Office Suite, including advanced Excel, PowerPoint and related financial systems
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal relationship skills including consultative and relationship management skills
* Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and investigative skills
* Solid knowledge and understanding of Edwards policies, procedures, and guidelines relevant to financial planning and month-end processes
* Good understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)
* Solid understanding of multi-relational impact of the Balance Sheet, P&L, and Cash Flow Statement and how journal entries affect each statement
* Solid knowledge of financial concepts and principles
* Expertise in own functional area and ability to coach others in various functional areas impacted within the business
  

  

Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

  
  

For California (CA), the base pay range for this position is $81,000 to $116,000 (highly experienced).

  
  

The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). Applications will be accepted while this position is posted on our Careers website.

  
  
  
  
  
  

Edwards is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer including protected Veterans and individuals with disabilities.

new_jobs.title: SENIOR MANAGEMENT ANALYST

**Definition**
--------------

The Newport Beach Municipal Operations Department seeks a motivated and detail-oriented individual to join the team as a **Senior Management Analyst** assigned to Trash & Recycle.

  
  

This position will serve as the technical expert for the Trash & Recycle Division, providing direct supervision and leadership to the team. The position will oversee the administration of the Trash & Recycle Division work plan and methods; assign work activities, projects and programs; monitor the work of contractors performing refuse collection work for the City; and implement policies and procedures to maintain compliance with California State and Orange County waste disposal mandates. The position will also inspect work sites, collection routes, and collections before, during and after completion to assure work is completed in a satisfactory and thorough manner. *The eligibility list established from this recruitment may be used to fill future Senior Management Analyst vacancies throughout the City.*

  
  

**Selection Components:**

* **Application Evaluation:** Applications will be accepted on a continuous basis with the first review date of **Mon****day,** **November 9, 2026 or until 150 applications are received- whichever occurs first**. Please apply immediately as this position may close at anytime. In order for the application package to be considered complete, candidates are required to attach their resume to their online application.
* **In-person Interview:** Tentatively scheduled for the **week of November 30, 2026**. Passing applicants will be placed on an eligibility list that may be used to fill future full-time vacancies as they occur.

**Schedule:**

* This position may work a 5/40 or 9/80 schedule

**Retirement:**

The City offers an excellent benefit package and membership in the California Public Employees' Retirement System (CalPERS). The retirement formula is based on appointment date and membership status with CalPERS and the employee is required to contribute 8% (or half the normal cost, whichever is higher) of pay towards the retirement benefit.

**Essential Duties**
--------------------

Please view online job specification for a more detailed description of specific job duties.

**Qualifications**
------------------

Please view online job specification for a more detailed description of specific qualifications.

**ADDITIONAL PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND ENVIRONMENTAL WORKING CONDITIONS:**
  
Work is performed in an office environment and may require occasional travel to off-site facilities, which could involve exposure to outdoor temperatures and inclement weather; equipment noise, equipment vibrations, vehicle and/or chemical fumes, chemicals such as cleaning solvents and grease, machinery and their moving parts, dust and water/moisture.

**Experience & Education and License/Certificate**
--------------------------------------------------

A combination of experience and education that would likely provide the required knowledge and abilities may be qualifying. A typical way to obtain the knowledge and abilities would be:

Experience: Four years of increasingly responsible professional level administrative experience. Public sector experience is highly desirable.
  
  
Education: Equivalent to a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in business, public administration, economics, or a related field.
  
  
License/Certificate: Due to the performance of some field duties which require the operation of a personal or City vehicle, a valid and appropriate California driver's license and an acceptable driving record are required.
  
  
**Please Note:** Candidates deemed most qualified, as reflected in their application materials, will be invited to continue in the recruitment process. The prospective candidate must successfully complete a thorough background review, including being fingerprinted by the Newport Beach Police Department. The resulting report of your conviction history, (if any), will be evaluated along with the other information received in connection with your application. Except as otherwise required by law, a criminal conviction will not necessarily disqualify you from the position. The nature, date, surrounding circumstances, and the relevance of the offense to the position applied for may, however, be considered.
  
  
**Disaster Service Worker:** In accordance with Government Code Section 3100, City of Newport Beach Employees, in the event of a disaster, are considered disaster service workers and may be asked to respond accordingly.

new_jobs.title: Buyer
new_jobs.description:
**Summary:** The Buyer is responsible for purchasing finished goods, components/packaging, and marketing collateral to support core business, new product launches, and inventory replenishment. This role creates and maintains Purchase Orders (POs) and Bills of Materials (BOMs) in the ERP system, maintains an accurate open order report, and proactively manages supply to meet service level and safety stock targets. The Buyer partners closely with other Buyers, Planning, the Supply Chain Director, and cross-functional teams to support on-time launches and achieve annual department goals.

The Buyer will conduct themselves in a highly professional manner and serve as a brand ambassador for ZO® Skin Health.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Purchase finished goods, components/packaging, and marketing collateral to meet demand, launch timelines, and inventory targets.

* Create, maintain, and manage POs in the ERP system; confirm pricing, lead times, MOQs, and delivery dates.

* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and other commercial terms aligned with cost and cash-flow objectives.

* Maintain accurate system data and order status updates, including supplier confirmations, component clear dates, and dispatch/shipping expectations.

* Review MRP, demand changes, and supply constraints; execute expedites, deferrals, and rephasing actions as needed to support customer service and inventory goals.

* Identify and implement cost reduction opportunities to support annual cost savings targets (e.g., price reductions, term improvements, freight optimization, alternate sourcing where applicable).

* Support supplier performance management by providing input for vendor scorecards (service, quality, communication, innovation, and responsiveness).

* Participate in defining, aligning, and documenting procurement processes and best practices; maintain adherence to internal SOPs and controls.

* Maintain appropriate inventory levels for packaging materials through correct use of planning parameters (e.g., safety stock, lead times, lot sizes) in collaboration with Planning.

* Support vendor, customer, and item setup activities as assigned.

* Assist with other Supply Chain/Operations activities as needed to support business requirements.

* Maintain a safe, organized work environment in accordance with company policies, as applicable to the work area.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

* Bachelor's degree required.

* 3+ years of purchasing/procurement experience; experience in cosmetics, wellness, pharmaceutical, or contract manufacturing environments is a plus.

* Strong working knowledge of MRP concepts, including demand signals, supply planning inputs, lead times, safety stock, and order management.

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data analysis, and reconciliation.

* ERP experience required (NetSuite strongly preferred); ability to become proficient quickly and operate independently.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills; ability to prioritize and manage multiple deadlines.

* Solid understanding of inventory management fundamentals and vendor/customer relationship management.

**Work Environment:**

The work environment is indoors in a professional office environment. The floor surfaces are carpeted in office areas and conference rooms with vinyl floor covering typical in hallways, break rooms and computer rooms.

**Work Hours:**

The work schedule is 5 days per week, 8 hours per day. Initial start time may vary, with work hours typically from 8am-5pm. Work hours and shifts are subject to change depending on operating business conditions and needs. The position resides in Orange County but is hybrid with 2 days being remote work.

**Physical and Mental Demands:**

Sedentary, exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, or negligible amounts of force frequently, to move objects. This job also requires constant sitting. Constant use of the upper extremities is required to reach, handle, and position tools and equipment. The employee must know and follow proper safety protocols and maintain a professional and polished appearance.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** None

  

**Salary Range: $68,000 - $87,000**

Equal Opportunity Employer  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Join Crusoe’s Cloud Finance team, playing a key role in driving Financial Planning & Analysis in support of our dynamic and growing Cloud business. You will work on financial analysis across revenue, cost, and capital investment workstreams. Your work will directly influence strategic financial decisions, drive operational efficiency, and enhance our finance function.

We’re seeking a results-driven professional with 4+ years of experience who is inspired to play a hands-on role in defining strategic financial targets and driving implementation amidst rapid growth

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Cloud Deal Analysis: Conduct financial analysis and modeling for customer deals — evaluating pricing, contract terms, ROI, and margin impact to support the sales team and ensure deals meet financial thresholds
* Capital Investment Analysis: Support financial modeling for infrastructure investment decisions including GPU purchases, colocation site evaluations, and build-vs-buy analysis for data center opportunities
* Cost & Unit Economics: Support GPU total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis and cost benchmarking across the deployment portfolio
* Competitive Intelligence: Help maintain competitor financial models, track industry developments, and translate competitive data into insights that inform pricing, investment, and strategic decisions
* Capital Raise Support: Support creation of models, presentations, and diligence materials for debt and equity fundraising events
* Process Improvement: Drive process improvements to enhance financial modeling and decision making efficiency
* Ad-Hoc Analysis: Conduct special projects and perform ad-hoc financial analyses as needed; serve as a point of contact internally and externally for finance inquiries

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 4+ years of experience in investment banking, venture capital, financial planning & analysis, or corporate finance
* Excellent skills in financial modeling and forecasting
* Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
* Team player who can work well independently and with limited direction
* Working knowledge of accounting principles and financial statements
* Detail-orientation with a focus on accuracy and precision
* A Bachelor's degree

**Bonus Points**

* MBA or technical degree (e.g., engineering, math, economics)
* Experience in businesses related to artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, enterprise software, and/or AI chip development
* Experience with data center economics, GPU infrastructure, or cloud consumption-based business models
* Familiarity with capex-intensive businesses and infrastructure investment analysis

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off
* Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $130,000 to $160,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

  
  

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical **Senior Financial Analyst** with **3-5 years of experience** to join our Financial Operations team. * Partner with BI teams to enhance and automate management reporting.

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, Power Query, and financial modeling techniques.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

* Financial/Management Data Analysis

* US GAAP Knowledge
* Manufacturing Finance
* Inventory Accounting
* Financial KPI Reporting
* Data Analysis & Analytics
* Business Partnering
* Process Improvement
* Executive Reporting
* Attention to Detail

* Opportunity to work closely with Finance, Accounting, and Operations leadership.
* Exposure to key operational and financial drivers of the business.

new_jobs.title: Senior Buyer / Global Supply Chain Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Foundry Robotics is building an AI-native robotics manufacturing company focused on deploying advanced assembly and production capability for leading robotics companies and national-security-critical hardware. Basically, we're building robots that build robots.  
  
We are reimagining manufacturing through advanced robotics. Our mission is to rebuild the American manufacturing industry as an AI-first, assembly-focused, dual-use contract manufacturer. We aim to empower manufacturers with intelligent, efficient, and adaptable robotic systems that redefine productivity and quality. As a senior leader on our manufacturing team, you will have a direct and significant impact on our product, culture, and ultimate success. This role is 100% in-person at our office in Emeryville, CA.

**The role**
------------

You will own procurement end to end, from placing purchase orders on Monday to building the supplier base we'll need over the next two years. This is a hybrid role where you'll manage day-to-day purchasing for active customer programs while developing the sourcing strategies, supplier network, and processes we need to scale.

* **Buyer side (execution):** turn customer BOMs into on-time, conforming material for every build, often for new products launched in weeks, not quarters.
* **GSM side (strategy):** qualify and develop a domestic-first, defense-ready supplier base; negotiate agreements; manage risk, cost and AS9100 supplier controls.

You'll be one of the first supply chain hires, working directly with production, quality, program management and our customers' engineering teams.  
  
**Founder mentality:** We love people who build like it’s their own company. You move fast, take ownership, and find a way through when the path isn’t obvious. You have the drive to make big things happen and the judgment to take smart risks along the way. If you prefer a clearly defined lane, a predictable pace, and all the answers before you start, there’s nothing wrong with that—but Foundry might not be the right fit.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Procurement and execution**

  + Own purchasing for high-mix, low-volume electromechanical builds: electronics, cable and harness, machined and sheet-metal parts, fasteners, motors, sensors and consumables.
  + Convert customer BOMs and quotes into purchase orders with complete requirements and flow-downs (quality clauses, DFARS/ITAR, certs, FAI, special processes).
  + Run expedites, shortages and allocation calls so NPI and production builds start on schedule.
  + Manage customer-furnished material and customer-directed suppliers alongside our own buys.
  + Maintain accurate purchasing data in our ERP: lead times, pricing, approved sources, open PO status.
* **Strategic sourcing and supplier management**

  + Build and maintain the Approved Supplier List; evaluate, qualify and onboard new suppliers per our AS9100 Purchasing procedure.
  + Develop a domestic and allied-nation supply base that supports defense customers and onshoring goals.
  + Negotiate pricing, LTAs, blanket orders, consignment and VMI programs that support both speed and cost.
  + Track supplier performance (OTD, quality, responsiveness) and report it at Management Review; drive SCARs with Quality.
  + Identify single-source, obsolescence and geopolitical risks early and stand up alternates.
* **Quality and compliance**

  + Prevent counterfeit parts: buy from authorized channels and enforce traceability and C of C requirements.
  + Partner with the Head of Quality on supplier audits, source inspection and nonconformance disposition.
  + Ensure compliance with ITAR/EAR, DFARS specialty-metals and cybersecurity flow-downs, and country-of-origin rules.

**Scaling the function**

* Help select and configure procurement tools, MRP logic and supplier portals as we grow.
* Feed DFM and quoting with real cost and lead-time data, and flag long-lead or hard-to-source parts during quote review.
* Support the supply plan for our new factory build-out, including robotic cell components and capital equipment.
* Write the playbooks and mentor future buyers and planners.

**What We're Looking for**
--------------------------

* 7+ years in procurement, purchasing or supply management for electromechanical hardware, with at least 3 years in a senior buyer, commodity manager or supply manager role.
* Experience in a contract manufacturer (EMS/CM) or high-mix, low-volume production environment.
* Hands-on buying across multiple commodities: electronic components, PCBAs, cable/harness, machined and sheet-metal parts.
* Working knowledge of AS9100 or ISO 9001 purchasing requirements: supplier approval, flow-downs, FAI, traceability and counterfeit-parts prevention.
* Familiarity with ITAR/EAR and DFARS requirements, and willingness to work on export-controlled programs. U.S. person status required (ITAR).
* Proven negotiation results on price, lead time and terms, plus experience building supplier relationships from scratch.
* Strong ERP/MRP skills (e.g., NetSuite, Odoo, Epicor or similar) and advanced spreadsheet skills.
* Comfort reading engineering drawings and BOMs and talking specs with engineers.
* Bias for action: you thrive with ambiguity, own outcomes, and move fast without cutting quality corners.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, robotics, medical device or autonomy hardware.
* Background building a supply chain function at an early-stage startup or a new factory.
* Established network of domestic machine shops, harness houses, PCBA suppliers and authorized distributors.
* Experience sourcing robotics and automation components (servos, actuators, cameras, grippers, industrial PCs) or capital equipment.
* Knowledge of DFARS 252.225 specialty metals, 252.246-7007/7008 counterfeit-part rules, NIST 800-171/CMMC flow-downs, and Buy American / TAA.
* Component obsolescence and lifecycle management (e.g., SiliconExpert, Z2Data).
*

Workforce Management Analyst

**About Us:**

Matrix Medical Network is the nation’s leading independent provider of comprehensive in-home health assessments, serving Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid and Commercial patients across all 50 states. With a network of 3,000 + clinicians, we deliver personalized Whole Person Care that includes diagnostic testing, risk identification, medication management and preventive health education, empowering people to better manage acute and chronic conditions. Guided by our mantra- *We see you. We hear you. We’ve got you.*- and our core values of Integrity, Accountability, Trust, Respect and Passion, we are committed to creating a culture where both patients and teammates feel valued, supported and heard.

**Why Work at Matrix?**

  

* The opportunity to work with one of the fastest growing companies in healthcare whose vision is to provide unparalleled quality and value to providers and members.
* A chance to work with great people on exciting projects.
* Our opportunities allow you to leverage your expertise and compassion, making a direct impact to the health and well-being of members.
* Competitive Compensation: Be rewarded for your effort and passion while making a difference in the community.

**About the role:**

**Type:** Full Time, Salary

**Compensation:** $92,000-$138,000

**Location:** Fully Remote, must be in the United States

**Hours:** Full Time Days

**Benefits Offered to include:** Medical, Dental, Vision, paid time off, paid holidays, 401K with company matching, voluntary life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, employee assistance program, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, additional voluntary benefits available.

**What to expect:**

This role turns member demand into the production hours that deliver completed visits, and makes sure every hour Matrix plans for is delivered as planned. The person owns the outbound capacity model, issues the locked hours requirement to each BPO, and governs vendor workforce performance against the SOW. They are also the business owner of workforce management and outbound campaign strategy in Genesys Cloud.

The role starts with the contact center: learning how BPO capacity on Matrix's Genesys platform, the dialer and vendor performance drive completed visits. As that foundation is in place, scope expands to the other channels that generate visits, including text, IVR and print. After a 60–90 day ramp, the role holds bounded authority to reallocate volume across vendors and campaigns within the locked plan.

**Key responsibilities**

**Demand-to-hours planning**

* Convert Enterprise Planning & Demand's forecast (required contacts and scheduled appointments by client, state and month) into production hours, using LCPH, contact rate, acceptance rate and dialable inventory.
* Split required hours between inbound and outbound, and across each BPO.
* Maintain the rolling 90-day plan and issue the 30-day locked hours requirement to each vendor monthly, by week and day-part.
* Reconcile planned against actual hours weekly and report hours-requirement accuracy.
* Check driven appointment volume against NP slot capacity with Clinical Operations before raising hours.

**Vendor workforce governance**

* Measure staffed hours delivered by each vendor against the locked requirement, by week and interval, using Genesys data.
* Enforce the SOW's workforce terms: interval staffing floor, billable hours cap, efficiency floor, adherence target, flex notices and overtime pre-authorization.
* Reconcile invoiced payroll hours against Genesys login hours monthly, and document variances and credits owed.
* Own the workforce measures in the joint vendor scorecard, and prepare workforce content for weekly reviews, monthly performance reviews and QBRs.
* Track vendor attrition, ramp and hiring-wave delivery against plan.

**Genesys Cloud workforce management (business owner)**

* Design the business unit and management unit structure (one unit per vendor), with adherence rules and permissions for each.
* Define activity-code mapping so productive hours mean on-queue and campaign time, matching the SOW definition. Genesys defaults count meetings and training as work time.
* Ensure every vendor's schedules exist in Genesys, built there or imported, so adherence is measured on Matrix's platform.
* Own adherence, shrinkage and staffed-hours reporting from Genesys.
* Use Genesys forecasting and capacity planning for inbound work such as member callbacks.

**Outbound campaign strategy**

* Decide list segmentation and allocation by vendor and campaign. Each contact list runs on one campaign at a time, so list allocation is the main lever for splitting volume.
* Set dialing mode, calling windows by member time zone, abandon-rate thresholds and attempt cadence within Matrix's dialer rules, including the 20-attempt annual cap.
* Partner with telecom on caller ID and attestation to protect contact rate.
* Genesys administrators carry out configuration changes; this role decides them.

**Daily allocation and channel monitoring**

* Review prior-day performance by source: contact rate, acceptance rate, LCPH, scheduled and completed visits.
* Make same-day list and hours adjustments within the decision rights below.
* Watch disposition trends for signs that a model input has drifted.
* Track text, IVR and print response as inputs to voice hours, and as scope expands, recommend channel-mix shifts.

**Reporting and leadership support**

* Build and maintain the vendor scorecard and capacity dashboards in Power BI.
* Produce a monthly capacity outlook and channel performance summary with explicit recommendations.
* Contribute to ExCo materials, growing toward presenting portions of them.
